validationNotes: Baseline b8995f2e, clean worktree/index and no overlapping jobs. Start 9326 names; current 9329 by real dist/cards.json nameKey. All prior definitions, IDs, reference images, catalogue and save formats preserved.

Full official abilities, stats, 7 original/reprint images visually reviewed. Four same-name Final Wars reprints are not counted separately. Current restrictions verified. Study/Ballista have one same-name print each. Unrelated Brooks search hits excluded.

Ballista uses actual opposing battle creature civilization, not the effect source. Fire/non-Fire battles, ordinary destruction, blocker/no-player attack, cost 4 boundary, both entry turns, hand versus grave/mana/deck entry, noncreature exclusion, duplicate sources and ignored watcher covered. QA33523 reproduced as the Fire Nagnag effect/non-Fire Genocide Worm fighter analogue; exact unregistered Duelnyan Emperor sequence is not claimed.

Study reuses native Judge318 and blocked-attacker capture. Both seats cover win/tie/loss, optional bounce/decline, exact attacker identity, no ordinary target choice, source removal, JSON continuation, Genmu/seal/GG suppression and no attack.

Final Wars uses the existing private Look/reveal/bottom-order pipeline. Official KGM search 198 prints over four pages and every detail face rarity verified; 43 named faces recorded. Creature filter excludes KGM King Cells; Master/Victory/name-only creatures are not KGM. Both seats test any number zero/one/two, top-five boundary, private residual order, short library, Genmu, encrypted storage and opponent projections.

71 focused tests verified in split runs and 302 related regressions (180 block/battle, 78 entry/look, 44 online), total 373. All failures were test-fixture assumptions and were resolved with focused reruns; no runtime change after initial focused checks. Legal forty-card seeded game preserves all 80 physical IDs and JSON actions through completion.

npm run check, audit, target9500 and baseline invariants passed. Historical unfinished whole-suite/long groups and prior individual/reprint deferrals preserved. Newly held candidates are not registered or counted. No push/publication/Netlify update.
